name: web-lilac-oops-something-went-wrong-error-card-above-black-footer
title: Lilac Error Card with Black Footer
whatItIs: A mobile error screen on lilac with a white rounded card topped by a pink strip reading 'We are experiencing some issues', a bold 'Oops, something went wrong' heading, plain instructions and an error ID, then a black footer with an outlined Status page pill, office and registered entity details with country flags and a five-item bottom tab bar.
whatItMeans: A calm lilac card and a clear error ID make a failure feel handled, and the status link gives the user somewhere to go.
techniques: Pink alert strip on top of a white card
Bold heading followed by plain instructions
Error ID in bold for support
Outlined pill for the status page
Black footer with flags and legal details

vocabulary.definition: A code the user can quote to support.
A coloured band on a card announcing a status.
A page showing whether services are working.
